title.zh: 通往 E3 之路 · 第 2 天

subtitle.en: Detail goes onto the walls, towers and windows, while the style of the battlements is still being debated.
subtitle.zh: 墙体、塔楼和窗户都加上了细节，城垛的风格则还在争论中。

translator.note: 原文 4 张图；图片链接指向原文上传的原图（其中一张原文未提供更大尺寸）。

blocks.en: Here is the progress for today. Detail has been added to the rest of the walls and towers as well as windows and other smaller features.
blocks.zh: 这是今天的进展。其余的墙体和塔楼都加上了细节，还有窗户和其他更小的构件。

blocks.en: We've had some discussions about the style of the battlements so those might change tomorrow or after.
blocks.zh: 我们就城垛的风格讨论了几次，所以它们明天或者之后再改。

blocks.en: Here are the new modular pieces that were done for detailing:
blocks.zh: 下面是为做细节新做的模块化部件：

blocks.en: We just finished the day by meeting with the architects and discussing the interior layout of the space so tomorrow I'll start on the interior building and ruin walls.
blocks.zh: 今天我们最后是跟建筑师开了个会，讨论这片空间的内部布局，所以明天我会开始做内部建筑和废墟墙体。
